title: Best of Bhutan | Group Tour Package
highlights: Embark on a thrilling Bhutan adventure, exploring rich culture, ancient monasteries, and vibrant cities, while embracing the country’s unique traditions and natural beauty.
Visit Paro’s Tiger’s Nest Monastery, perched 3,120 metres on a cliff offering panoramic views and a spiritual experience unlike any other.
Explore Bhutan’s second-oldest fortress monastery (Dzong) at Punakha, strategically located between the Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu rivers.
Journey through Dochula Pass at 3,100 metres, marvelling at the 108 memorial chortens, and enjoy sweeping views of the snow-capped Himalayan peaks.
Admire the architecture of Khamsum Yulley Namgyal Chorten, built in 1990, showcasing intricate carvings and beautiful murals that reflect Bhutanese Buddhist art.
inclusions: Transfer from Paro International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
2 nights stay in Thimphu with breakfast and lunch or dinner
Leisure Time at Thimphu Local Market
2 nights stay in Punakha with breakfast and lunch or dinner
Visit to Punakha Dzong and Chimi L Hakhang Temple
2 nights stay in Paro with breakfast and lunch or dinner
Transfer from Standard Hotel to Paro International Airport
Daily Government Royalties and Taxes (INR 1200 per person per night)
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
Any extra excursions or sightseeing apart from the above specified itinerary.
know_before_you_go: Images are for representation purpose only.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.

Indians must pay the Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) of Rs 1200 per person/per night. Children below 5 years are exempted from SDF, while kids between 6 and 12 years of age, will get 50% concession.
To obtain entry in Bhutan, Indian tourists must carry their passports with a minimum 6 months validity and make the payment of SDF.
Plastic has been banned since 1999 in Bhutan, therefore, it is advised to carry plastic/plastic items.
Keep your arms and legs covered while visiting a Dzong (fortress-monastery).
Ask for permission from the attending authority before taking any photos or videos inside places like monasteries.
In Bhutan, Tuesday is ‘Dry Day’. This means locals don’t drink alcohol on Tuesday. So it would be respectful to avoid alcohol on Tuesdays too.
It’s illegal for tobacco to be sold in Bhutan. Tourists can bring cigarettes into the country, but can only smoke them in designated places.
Bhutan does not have a micro (or nano) SIM card. So check your mobile device for SIM compatibility before visiting Bhutan.
Ask your local guide to help you purchase a SIM on arrival, as Bhutan supports 2 networks: B-Mobile SIM and TashiCell.
Credit cards are widely accepted in major cities and tourist areas. However, it is recommended to carry some cash.
The official currency in Bhutan is the Bhutanese Ngultrum (BTN). It is advisable to exchange currency at banks or authorised exchange bureaus.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

Rescheduling Policy for Private (Standard & Deluxe Package) & Group Bookings: 1) If rescheduling is made 7 days after the booking date till 15 days prior to the date of travel then 30.0% of the total tour cost will be charged as rescheduling fees. | 2) If rescheduling is made 0 days to 15 days before the date of travel then 100.0% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. | 3) If bookings are made 15 days before the date of travel no rescheduling & modifications will be made.
Rescheduling Policy for Private (Super Deluxe) & Hotel Specific Bookings: No modification or rescheduling will be catered. A standard cancellation policy will be applicable for such cases.

Cancellation After Rescheduling: Clients who reschedule their tours or treks but later decide to cancel will be subject to our standard cancellation policy. Any rescheduling fees paid will be non-refundable.
Please note that on Saturdays and Sundays, the Phuentsholing Bhutan permit office remains closed.
Please note, the provided vehicle is for point-to-point services only. Any extra usage beyond the itinerary will incur additional charges, payable in cash on the spot.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Paro | Transfer to Thimphu | Leisure Time at Thimphu Local Market
days.desc: Welcome to Bhutan! Upon arrival at the Paro International Airport, get transferred to your hotel in Thimphu. Post check in, relax for a while and later, board your transfer to explore Thimphu Local Market. Once there, head to the vibrant Thimphu Main Street and indulge in shopping. Also, visit the local craft bazaar, a treasure trove of Bhutanese art and crafts showcasing the rich craftsmanship of the country. Post-tour, you’ll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Leisure Time at Thimphu Local Market

days.title: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Embark on a sightseeing tour of Thimphu. Visit the National Library, home to ancient manuscripts related to Bhutan’s rich history. Explore the National Institute for Zorig Chusum, where traditional arts and crafts are taught. Immerse yourself in Bhutanese culture through exhibits at Simply Bhutan, an interactive museum. Then, head to Pangri Zampa Monastery, known for its astrology school and tranquil surroundings. After a day of cultural exploration, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Punakha | Visit to Punakha Dzong and Chimi L Hakhang Temple
days.desc: Today, check out and embark on a scenic drive to Punakha, where you'll be treated to stunning views of the Himalayas en route. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and unwind. Later, set out to explore Punakha's cultural gems. Begin with a visit to Chimi Lhakhang, the renowned "temple of fertility," where visitors come to seek blessings. Continue to Punakha Dzong, beautifully located at the confluence of the Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu rivers. After your tour, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Visit to Punakha Dzong and Chimi L Hakhang Temple

days.title: Punakha Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer for a sightseeing tour of Punakha. Start with a scenic hike along the banks of Mo Chhu, leading to the amazing Khamsum Yulley Namgyal Chorten, and soak in the serene surroundings. Continue your journey and visit Sangchhen Dorji Lhuendrup Lhakhang Nunnery, a vital centre for promoting and preserving Bhutan's spiritual heritage. Afterwards, you’ll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Paro | Visit to Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong
days.desc: Check out and get transferred to Paro, with a stop at the Simtokha Dzong, one of Bhutan's oldest fortresses. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel. In the afternoon, explore the historic Ta Dzong, once a watchtower, now home to the National Museum, showcasing ancient Thangkas (paintings) and cultural artefacts. Afterwards, take a short walk down to Rinpung Dzong, which represents a beautiful combination of Bhutanese grandeur and a monastery. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Paro Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Kyichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan’s oldest temples, and pay your respects while soaking in its serene atmosphere. Next, head to Satsam Chencho Tshongkhang, the starting point for a scenic 3 km hike (each side) to the Tiger’s Nest Monastery. Upon reaching the monastery, explore its sacred halls and admire its breathtaking location. Later, visit the dramatic ruins of Drukgyel Dzong and enjoy stunning valley views. Afterwards, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and board your pre-booked transfer to the Paro International Airport to board your flight for onward journey. This is where your trip comes to an end.
